capabilities: Set a date and time on any checkbox via a clock button, calendar and time menus
Show a desktop notification when a reminder is due, with Done, Snooze and Open actions
List all vault reminders in a sidebar grouped by Overdue, Today, Tomorrow, Next 7 days and Later
Store reminders as plain text in the task line so notes stay readable without the plugin
Show reminders that came due while Obsidian was closed on next start
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states notifications require Obsidian to be running, phones and tablets only get in-app messages, and the plugin works fully offline with no network use.
problem: Obsidian's task lists have no built-in way to schedule a reminder or get notified when a task comes due.
summary: Task reminder plugin that adds a clock button to checkboxes for setting date/time reminders, with desktop notifications and a sidebar list sorted by due date.
